en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small arched pedestrian bridge over a canal or river, leading toward traditional wooden houses with steep metal roofs. In the background rises a large castle‑like building with a round corner tower and dome. Leafless tree branches frame the top of the image. A lone person walks across the bridge. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Uppsala and include publishing information.
